venues.currentness: confirmed: the active official operator site publishes current programming, and its theatre page continues to publish the basic-stage chart.
venues.representativeConfiguration: Issuer-defined basic stage use, 189 seats. The page expressly distinguishes this basic form from event-specific stage-shape changes that alter seating.
venues.numberedSeatEvidence: complete and feasible for later lossless transcription: the chart visibly prints A-I, BL, BR, and J identifiers. The issuer-labelled groups reconcile directly as A-I 162, BL/BR 10, and J 17 = 189; this arithmetic is evidence review, not a range transcription.
venues.issuerOwnershipAndCapacity: The official page states 189 seats for basic stage use, and the chart's named rows/side blocks provide the seat ownership. Published capacity is 189 for this selected configuration.
venues.accessibilityRemovableMultiConfiguration: The reviewed material does not define a separately numbered wheelchair conversion. Stage-shape changes can alter seating, so no other event configuration may be mixed into the basic form.
venues.reason: The current official page and its current-linked chart define one complete numbered basic configuration without capacity fitting or geometry-derived ownership.
venues.nextTwoPassRequirements: Independently re-read every printed A-I, BL/BR, and J ID and gap; verify 162 + 10 + 17 = 189 from issuer labels; retain the basic-form boundary and do not infer accessibility replacements.

venues.reason: Current/current-linked official evidence supplies one complete numbered, issuer-subtotalled representative diagram. Variable event categories remain a disclosure, not a reason to merge configurations or create IDs.
venues.nextTwoPassRequirements: Independently re-read every printed ID and boundary for all five issuer seating categories; verify 64 + 32 + 49 + 52 + 40 = 237; preserve the 座敷 annotations and do not infer wheelchair/removable relations or event-specific variants.
